title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Service Area, Distance Surcharge and Delivery Limit
content:
Distance for Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery is measured in road miles from the delivery center to the delivery address. Each service level covers a set number of road miles without surcharge, charges a surcharge for each road mile beyond that, and does not offer delivery beyond a maximum distance.

## Distance terms by service level

| Service level | Road miles covered without surcharge | Surcharge per road mile beyond that | Road miles beyond which delivery is not offered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |
| Threshold Delivery | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |
| White Glove Delivery | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 75 | $2.50 | 150 |

The three distance terms are the same at all six levels.

## Bands

| Road miles from the delivery center | Position |
|---|---|
| Up to and including 75 | Within the service area; no distance surcharge |
| More than 75, up to and including 150 | Delivery offered; a surcharge of $2.50 for each road mile beyond 75 |
| More than 150 | Beyond the distance at which delivery is offered |

## Worked distances (hypothetical addresses)

- 75 road miles: within the 75 miles covered; no surcharge.
- 76 road miles: 1 mile beyond 75; surcharge $2.50.
- 120 road miles: 45 miles beyond 75; surcharge $2.50 multiplied by 45, or $112.50.
- 150 road miles: 75 miles beyond 75; surcharge $187.50; delivery is offered, as 150 miles is not beyond the limit.
- 151 road miles: beyond the 150 miles at which delivery stops being offered.
